description: Apply one API change across three modules without changing observed outputs.
prompt: Task files are under ./workspace/ relative to your working directory; every path below is relative to ./workspace/. Change formatMinor in repo/money.mjs to take one object argument, formatMinor({ amountMinor, currency }), and update every caller under repo/ so that invoiceLine and totalLine return exactly what they return today. After the change, the old two-argument call formatMinor(1234, "USD") must throw a TypeError. Do not rename any export. Keep every module a self-contained ES module that imports only other files under repo/ by relative path: no packages, file access, network or subprocesses.
